title: Bring your own deployment: Vercel
description: Imported by OWN-0 from runtime/executive/mission-imports/2026-10-23-customer-ownership.json. Source ticket: OWN-DEPLOY.
objective: A customer deploys a project to their own Vercel account from KoreLumina, with its environment variables set, real build progress and logs, the live URL, and rollback to the previous deployment.
risks: The Vercel connection is used only for deployments the customer starts; a pasted token is used once and never kept.
Deployment needs explicit approval every time.
The first live deployment happens only on the owner's own Vercel account, with the owner's approval.

tasks.title: Deploy to Vercel
acceptanceCriteria: Creates or reuses a Vercel project, sets its environment variables, uploads the files and deploys
Shows the build's real progress and logs and the deployment URL
Pro and above, enforced in Runtime

tasks.title: Link the Vercel project to the customer's GitHub repository
acceptanceCriteria: When the project was exported to the customer's GitHub, the Vercel project is linked to it so later pushes redeploy without KoreLumina

tasks.title: Roll back
acceptanceCriteria: Promotes the previous deployment on request

tasks.title: Deployment window in the Knowledge Operations design
acceptanceCriteria: Deployment history, progress, logs and rollback
The owner approves it visually and its UI contract is certified
